pl-l4d38c1-d1e115.summary: Turns to vows and defines a vow as the testimony of a spontaneous promise, which should properly be made to God and about God's things; there are also vows of fools, which must be broken.
claims: A vow is a spontaneous promise to God.

pl-l4d38c1.summary: Turns to vows: a vow is the testimony of a spontaneous promise, properly made to God and about the things of God; there are also vows of fools, which are to be broken.
claims: A vow is a spontaneous promise made to God about divine things.
Foolish vows are to be broken.
